top_news.title: She Starts
top_news.summary: As artificial intelligence reshapes workplace expectations, women returning to employment after career breaks are increasingly exploring AI-integrated learning to rebuild their professional capabilities. With AI literacy, digital collaboration and practical technology skills becoming relevant across industries, conventional upskilling alone may no longer adequately prepare career returners for today's workplace. AI also presents an opportunity to narrow the skills gap. As both experienced professionals and returning candidates adapt to emerging technologies, women re-entering the workforce have an opportunity to develop capabilities aligned with current employer expectations. Against this backdrop, She Starts, a remote-first career restart platform, is reporting growing interest in its AI-integrated programmes, which combine practical learning, recent workplace experience and structured career preparation. She Starts Supports Over 500 Women She Starts has already supported more than 500 women through its career restart ecosystem, extending its reach globally through a hiring network of 300+ across 25+ countries. Its participants include women returning after motherhood, caregiving responsibilities, relocation and extended career breaks, ranging from those seeking to resume previous careers to others exploring new professional opportunities. Participation in AI-integrated career restart programmes is gaining momentum as women recognise the importance of developing current workplace capabilities alongside their existing qualifications and experience, while addressing challenges associated with employment gaps. Increasing participation among Indian expatriate women also highlights the growing interest in flexible learning and location-independent career pathways among those living outside their home countries. Rather than focusing exclusively on certifications, She Starts aims to address the broader challenges of career re-entry through practical learning, recent professional experience, confidence rebuilding and structured employment preparation. 40+ AI-Integrated Programmes Across Different Career Domains At the centre of She Starts' approach is the integration of artificial intelligence into professional learning, helping participants understand how emerging technologies are applied in everyday workplace activities. Its portfolio spans 40+ career restart-friendly courses across different domains

articles.title: She Starts
articles.summary: As artificial intelligence reshapes workplace expectations, women returning to employment after career breaks are increasingly exploring AI-integrated learning to rebuild their professional capabilities. With AI literacy, digital collaboration and practical technology skills becoming relevant across industries, conventional upskilling alone may no longer adequately prepare career returners for today's workplace. AI also presents an opportunity to narrow the skills gap. As both experienced professionals and returning candidates adapt to emerging technologies, women re-entering the workforce have an opportunity to develop capabilities aligned with current employer expectations. Against this backdrop, She Starts, a remote-first career restart platform, is reporting growing interest in its AI-integrated programmes, which combine practical learning, recent workplace experience and structured career preparation. She Starts Supports Over 500 Women She Starts has already supported more than 500 women through its career restart ecosystem, extending its reach globally through a hiring network of 300+ across 25+ countries. Its participants include women returning after motherhood, caregiving responsibilities, relocation and extended career breaks, ranging from those seeking to resume previous careers to others exploring new professional opportunities.
